### any command, piped

```sh
set -o pipefail   # so $? is the tool's exit code, not siga's
build 2>&1 | siga pipe; siga end $?
```

### a failing piped command ends red, with its own exit code

```sh
set -o pipefail
build 2>&1 | siga pipe; siga end $?   # exits 3, bar ends red
```

### OSC 9;4 from a shell script (the standard progress escape)

```sh
work() {
    for i in $(seq 0 5 100); do
        printf '\033]9;4;1;%d\033\\' "$i"   # ESC ] 9;4;1;<percent> ST
        sleep 0.2
    done
    printf '\033]9;4;0\033\\'               # clear
}
set -o pipefail
work | siga pipe; siga end $?
```
